title: VTA DIDs — Keys Add — payload
description: Add a newly minted key to a role of a key-role identity — a post-quantum attestation key beside a classical one, a second operational key. `update` and `authenticator` keys are not added.

did.description: The key-role identity, by DID (for a `did:scid` identity, the DID without `src`).

role.description: The role the key joins: `attestation`, `operational` or `messaging`. Any other is refused with `vta/dids:notApplicableToRole`.

keyType.description: Algorithm of the key to mint; must suit the role (CONVENTIONS.md §2.2).

expectedVersionId.description: Optimistic-concurrency precondition: the version identifier (method profile §3) the caller based this change on, for example `keys/list`'s `versionId`. The VTA MUST refuse with `vta/dids:versionConflict` if the identity has moved past it. Not optional for anything a person looked at.

dryRun.description: Compute and return the preview without writing anything but the plan (CONVENTIONS.md §6.1). Absent reads as false.

previewId.description: Apply exactly the plan a previous dry run of this same request returned, or nothing (CONVENTIONS.md §6.1); what every approval is bound to.

reason.description: Why the change is being made, for the audit trail and for the other approvers. Never published.

Response.title: VTA DIDs — Keys Add — response payload

preview.description: Present when `outcome` is `preview`, `pendingApproval` or `awaitingRecoveryProof`: the plan, and what an approval is bound to.

newVersionId.description: Present when `outcome` is `applied`: the version identifier of the change. Pass it as the next change's `expectedVersionId`.

keys.description: Every key whose state this change sets or would set, after the change.
